## [2.0.0-dev.2](https://github.com/riky-dev/morphe-patches/compare/v2.0.0-dev.1...v2.0.0-dev.2) (2026-09-23)

### ✨ New Features

* **vn:** hide export nags and projects ads on 2.20.0 ([b8d5826](https://github.com/riky-dev/morphe-patches/commit/b8d5826062a5af85f8ff855afed1392c22b04df1))

patches.name: Hide export nags
patches.description: Hides the post-export review dialog and the inspiring-tips guidance banner.

patches.name: Hide projects ads
patches.description: Hides AdsLayout banners (Projects list and other in-app ad slots).

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium features, removes watermark, hides Pro tab, and hides the home upgrade-to-Pro banner.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces CapCut 9.0 VIP gates to true (VipSubscribeManager, SubscribeImpl, UserVipInfo, benefits). Cloud-gated assets may still fail.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Spoofs premium/unlocked state to disable ad-gated behavior.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes banner, native, cover and interstitial ads and unlocks premium features.

patches.name: Unlock map regions
patches.description: Spoof Komoot Maps ownership client-side (world pack / owned regions in shop and offline UI). Server-side limits may still apply: offline tile download auth, sync overwriting local state, and Play receipt validation. Does not replace a real Play Store purchase.

patches.name: Unlock Premium features
patches.description: Unlock Premium features. Some features are not possible to patch (server sided), such as saving a multi-days hike.
